notes: Libretto by Emanuel Schikaneder (1791). Words as printed in the Edition Peters vocal score, which the app follows where it differs from the libretto: Papageno's "Weibchen! Täubchen, meine Schöne!", "ich plauderte, plauderte", "und drum geschieht es mir schon recht" (the libretto has "darum"), "Herzenskämmerlein" in one word, "'s ist umsonst" (sung on one note, written 's‿ist here), "misfällt" with one s, as the print divides it (mis-fällt), "wohl so lass ich's diesmal sein" without a comma, "Nun, ich warte noch, es sei! Ich warte noch, nun! es sei", the second "du falsche! Welt!" with the print's exclamation mark before "Welt", "doch brennt' es euch", "vergass", "Glockenspiel" and "muss" with ss, the print's apostrophes ("Lieb'", "End'", "wenn's", "brennt's", "ist's", "eh'", "ich's", "geh'n", "seh'n", the Boys' "Halt' ein!"), and the repeats of the music ("Papagena" three times, "plauderte", "drum geschieht es mir schon recht", "schöne Mädchen, denkt an mich", "rufet nur: ja oder nein", "alles stille", "Papageno, frisch hinauf", "nun wohlan, es bleibt dabei", "gute Nacht, du falsche Welt", "ihr würdet auch nach Mädchen geh'n", "ich Narr! vergass der Zauberdinge", "ich muss mein liebes Mädchen seh'n", "klinget, Glöckchen, klinget!" and "bringt mein Mädchen her", and the Boys' "halt' ein!" and "man lebt nur einmal, dies sei dir genug"). The spoken "Eins", "zwei", "drei" between the panpipe calls have no notes and are left out. Each Boy has his own line, with the same words. IPA follows sung German stage diction: final -er, -ern as [ɐ]; the prefixes er-, ver-, zer- with [ɛr]; r elsewhere rolled or flipped; ch as [ç] after front vowels and [x] after back vowels; glottal stops [ʔ] before initial vowels; final b d g devoiced.
